groups.problem: The isAccessTokenId matcher's grant check on line 483 is broken: it reads substring(3,5) instead of (4,6) and/or returns false on equality instead of on mismatch, so it doesn't actually check the expected grant.
groups.rationale: All point at the same grant-comparison line in AssertEvents.isAccessTokenId, and one line edit fixes it (!items[0].substring(4,6).equals(expected)). Some report only the index error or only the inversion, but the fix is the same.

groups.problem: getShortcut is documented as a roughly three-letter shortcut, but the encoder/decoder needs exactly two characters, so conforming custom grants produce undecodable token IDs.
groups.rationale: All describe the same mismatch between the documented shortcut length and the decoder's fixed two-character grant field. Some suggest fixing the docs and others suggest validating at registration.

groups.problem: In the AccessTokenContext constructor, the rawTokenId null check validates grantType again instead of rawTokenId.
groups.rationale: Same line, same copy-paste bug and the same fix.
